story.title: Keeper of the Quiet Veil
story.personality: Measured and observant; Noctis tests whether challengers stay composed when certainty disappears.
story.introDialogue: Beyond this door, confidence without patience becomes a weakness.
story.battleLine: Show me the decisions you make when the path goes dark.
story.postVictoryLine: You found direction without needing light. Pyra is waiting beyond the next gate.

story.title: Heart of the Ember Court
story.personality: Direct and passionate; Pyra respects endurance more than spectacle.
story.introDialogue: A strong flame is not the loudest. It is the one that survives every storm.
story.battleLine: Let your team's resolve burn brighter than mine.
story.postVictoryLine: Your resolve held. Marinus will test whether it can bend without breaking.

story.title: Tactician of the Tidal Hall
story.personality: Calm and adaptive; Marinus changes rhythm until a challenger reveals their habits.
story.introDialogue: Every battle leaves a current. Skilled Trainers learn to change with it.
story.battleLine: Adapt, or let the tide decide for you.
story.postVictoryLine: You changed course without losing purpose. Drakon guards the final ascent.

story.title: Warden of the High Throne
story.personality: Proud but fair; Drakon believes strength matters only when it protects something greater.
story.introDialogue: You crossed shadow, flame, and tide. Now prove your strength has a purpose.
story.battleLine: Climb beyond your limits, or end your League run here.
story.postVictoryLine: Your strength carries every bond that brought you here. The Champion's chamber is open.

story.title: Guardian of the League Crown
story.personality: Steady and deeply attentive; Aurelius judges the journey behind a Trainer, not merely their strongest move.
story.introDialogue: Eight badges opened these doors. Your choices through a region in crisis brought you to the final one.
story.battleLine: Let every bond, every setback, and every victory speak through your team.
story.postVictoryLine: The League recognizes more than your strength. It recognizes the Trainer you chose to become.
